fusions.name: Cold Dead Weight
fusions.desc: A heavy strike at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 15 blunt damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Leaden Hiss
fusions.desc: Hisses metal-tainted venom across the 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 poison damage to everything in the cone, with a 30% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scales Gone Grey
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8%.

fusions.name: Unyielding Coil
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and your poison resistance by 8%.
